intent: Carry the technical restart outcome into the social aftershock of work stoppage, then verify the real reporting climate through the next hazard signal.

stages.purpose: establish the technical outcome and the delay/communication history people remember
separate reporting protection from crew assignment authority and social perception
observe whether the next abnormal condition is reported, chilled, or routed separately from assignment decisions

presentation_rules: Do not reduce the issue to whether a supervisor or worker is right; distinguish formal protection, legitimate assignment factors, and perceived retaliation.
Expose the social and operational tradeoffs of every intervention route without labeling a correct answer.
When stopwork_culture_result is written, update the same 15:32 panel from reporting focus to culture verdict.
